question_answered: What is one generic treatment effect if every unit-period row is treated as independent?
main_problem: Mixes treatment periods and repeats the same final outcome across rows.
when_it_can_be_useful: Quick exploratory baseline, not a final panel causal design.

question_answered: What is the effect of final-period treatment on the final outcome?
main_problem: Ignores earlier treatment effects and treatment-history questions.
when_it_can_be_useful: When the causal question is explicitly about one period only.

question_answered: What is the effect of treatment in each period on the final outcome?
main_problem: Requires balanced histories and credible observed treatment history controls.
when_it_can_be_useful: When treatment timing and treatment history are central to the decision.
